paragraphs: A Mercedes-Benz M159 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Mercedes already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most M159 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six M159-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Mercedes-Benz M159 engine?
faqLeft.a: The M159 is Mercedes-AMG's 6.2-litre naturally aspirated V8, produced between 2010 and 2014 exclusively for the SLS AMG. It's the most powerful naturally aspirated production V8 ever fitted to a Mercedes-Benz.

faqLeft.q: Which Mercedes models use the M159?
faqLeft.a: The M159 was only ever fitted to the SLS AMG (C197) — in standard SLS AMG, SLS AMG GT, and SLS AMG Black Series form. It was never used in any other Mercedes-Benz model.

faqLeft.q: Does the M159 differ between SLS AMG variants?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The standard SLS AMG produces 563 hp, the SLS AMG GT produces 583 hp, and the SLS AMG Black Series produces 631 hp. The engine calibration differs between variants, particularly for the Black Series which uses a unique engine management setup.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-Benz M159 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500, placing it on the AMG V8 tier. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on M159 rebuilds across all three SLS AMG variants — standard, GT, and Black Series.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild a M159 from an SLS AMG Black Series?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M159 in the Black Series uses a unique engine calibration, which we account for during the rebuild process.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Mercedes-Benz M159 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SLS AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an M159 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most M159 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given the different calibrations between the standard SLS, SLS GT, and Black Series — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
